answer: Give every account a door it must open alone, and Appointed switchboard operator licence with switchboard operators certification is that door. With a licence operators renew after shift audits, the mesa of entry is small for one agent and crushing for a farm. An honest agent passes the gate once in seconds; the farm passes it a hundred times, and the canyon of all those crossings is a debt no payout settles. The ivory is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
